entries.reason: Deferred to inbox #509: an `expiresAt` the TIMESTAMP columns cannot hold (before 1970, after 2038-01-19, or an offset past ±18:00 that java.time cannot read) is refused 400 since this change; JSON Schema's date-time admits it.

Accepted by design: `role` is an open token whose admissible set is the applications' (ADR 0079; `BlobRole` in _common), and a role no application declares is the 400 this operation declares — the contract's own example `A` is one.

Deferred to inbox #509: an `expiresAt` the TIMESTAMP columns cannot hold (before 1970, after 2038-01-19, or an offset past ±18:00 that java.time cannot read) is refused 400 while binding; JSON Schema's date-time admits it. Which keys a link carries for its `role` is the schema's own rule (`CreateShareRequest`'s `if`/`then`/`else`), no longer a 400 the schema admits.

Deferred to inbox #509: the stateful sequence re-issues a link with an `expiresAt` in the year 952, which the TIMESTAMP columns cannot hold and the server refuses 400; JSON Schema's date-time admits it.

Accepted: the request body is optional (requestBody required: false) and Jackson reads a JSON null body as no body, so the case is the request without one, which the contract allows; the handler then answers the unknown job's 404. No contract declares a nullable body, and refusing a literal null would need a reader of its own for one operation.

Accepted by design: the refresh token travels in the cookie or the body, one of the two required — a rule across locations no schema states, declared as this operation's 400 (`missing token`); and no generated request carries a token the run holds.
